login.title: Sign in to OrderPilot
login.emailRequired: Enter your email, for example name@example.com.
login.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email. Check for an @ and a domain.
login.demoTitle: Open the demo as a team
login.demoHint: Six teams handle an order, in this order.
login.demoNote: In this demo the AI and Business Central are stand-ins, and every record is made up.
login.optionsFailed: The demo sign-in could not be checked. You can still sign in with your email.

sessionEnded.title: Your session ended
sessionEnded.description: Sign in again to carry on. This page stays as you left it, and anything you typed is kept.

hero.lead: One place for every order, from the customer's PO to the goods leaving.

read.title: AI reads
read.body: It reads each document and picks out the customer, items, quantities and prices.

decide.title: Rules decide
decide.body: Fixed rules compare quantities, prices and PO references across the documents, and check stock.

approve.title: People approve
approve.body: The right person confirms anything uncertain. Business Central stays the system of record.

twoStep.title: Enter your code
twoStep.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for OrderPilot.

recovery.label: Recovery code
recovery.hint: Each recovery code works once, for example ABCDE-FGHJK-LMNPQ.
recovery.required: Enter one of your recovery codes.

twoStep.lockedIn_one: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {{count}} minute, or use a recovery code.
twoStep.lockedIn_other: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {{count}} minutes, or use a recovery code.
twoStep.lockedInHours_one: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {{count}} hour, or use a recovery code.
twoStep.lockedInHours_other: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {{count}} hours, or use a recovery code.
twoStep.recentLock: Too many wrong codes were entered for your account in the last 7 days. If that was not you, someone may know your password.
twoStep.recoveryUsed_one: You signed in with a recovery code. {{count}} is left.
twoStep.recoveryUsed_other: You signed in with a recovery code. {{count}} are left.
twoStep.recoveryUsedLast: You signed in with your last recovery code. Make new ones in Settings.
